ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْ مَا نَطَقَ عَنِ الْهَوَى .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī mā naṭaqa `ani ‘l-hawā.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family who never spoke from his own desire!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْ مَا ضَلَّ عَنِ الْحَقِّ وَمَا غَوَى .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī mā ḍalla `ani ‘l-haqqi wa mā ghawā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family who never strayed from truth nor deviated!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ وَ أَلْبِسْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ لِبَاسَ التَّقْوَى .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, wa albisnā bi ‘ṣ-Ṣalāti `alayhi libāsa ‘t-taqwā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and clothe us by sending prayers upon him the garments of Allah-consciousness!
